1879060551.name: Dire Need
1879060551.desc: Costs 30% of your current power but greatly restores your morale.

1879064391.name: Passage of Shadow
1879064391.desc: Allows you to track the presence of the dead, the unseen, and ancient evil.

1879085127.name: Default Melee Attack
1879085127.desc: Auto-attack when wielding a two-handed weapon.

1879101511.name: Travel to Kinship House
1879101511.desc: Return quickly to your kinship's house. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879104839.name: Fungal Spores
1879104839.desc: Spores weave their way into the target, helping to speed the healing process.

1879113159.name: Clever Retort
1879113159.desc: Gain access to personal manoeuvres, replicating some of the coordination of a mighty fellowship.

1879130695.name: Elf Trick
1879130695.desc: A close-ranged attack that dazes foes around the target.

1879138631.name: Gooey Gourd
1879138631.desc: A gourd filled with sticky mud is launched at your opponent.

1879160007.name: Lithe Festival Horse
1879160007.desc: A horse from the Summer Festival.

1879212103.name: Perfect Snowball
1879212103.desc: This is probably the best snowball that has ever been made. Just the right weight. Just the right amount of moisture. Just the right number of ice shards to really take down your victim.

1879213895.name: A Chink in the Armour (Melee)
1879213895.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's scales, tearing them loose and exposing what lies beneath.

1879230023.name: Return to Galtrev
1879230023.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Men of Dunland, you're able to quickly return to Galtrev in Dunland. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879242311.name: Enduring Embers
1879242311.desc:
Using your knowledge of fire and all that burns, you heave handfuls of pitch soaked embers at your target. They burn hotter and hotter over time.

When your companion has Flanked the enemy, this skill will deal additional damage. <rgb=#FF7700>

The effects from this skill can stack up to 3 times.</rgb>

1879244871.name: Roar of the Eorlingas
1879244871.desc: You issue a loud cry drawing the heart out of the enemy, dealing damage and slightly increasing threat against the target.\n\n<rgb=#66ffff>Applies the Shout effect to you. Skill of the Eorlingas becomes Halt the Charge.</rgb>

1879245639.name: Debate the People
1879245639.desc: A strength that all Rune-keepers possess is the ability to speak well on any subject. This proves to be a great benefit in the midst of a heated debate, and this benefit can prove very potent and effective.

1879250759.name: Sign of Power: Inspiration
1879250759.desc: The Lore-master marks an enemy and allows his allies and their mounts to draw inspiration from fighting the marked foe.

1879255495.name: Inspirational Verse
1879255495.desc: You focus your energies and etchings toward supporting you and your allies finding inspiration in the verses.

1879271239.name: Fury of Blades
1879271239.desc: Deals AoE damage in front of the Champion.\n\nDamage is increased by 30% per pip consumed.

procEffects.description: DNT - Your skills have a chance to return a percent of your max health on hit
DNT - Blade skills have a  chance to cause their next attack to bypass a percentage of targets physical mitigation

1879271751.name: War-chant
1879271751.desc: Shout out to dishearten and impede advancing enemies.

procEffects.description: DNT - Whenever you block an attack, you will gain a small amount of critical defence.

1879295431.name: Tripwire
1879295431.desc: A tripwire trap can knock a monster down, sometimes creating the opportunity to use a Fellowship Manoeuvre.\n\nTrap remains for 1 minute after being placed.

1879302599.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Footsoldier)
1879302599.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879313735.name: Sweeping Riposte
1879313735.desc: Powerful attack that hits multiple enemies in front of you and cannot be blocked, parried, or evaded. This skill requires a parry event.

1879316039.name: Discipline: Riddermark
1879316039.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Riddermark</rgb>

The Riddermark Discipline turns your focus to steering the course of battle while maintaining your ability to protect allies from enemy assault.

1879316167.name: Frog
1879316167.desc: Summons a frog to keep you company.

1879316295.name: Levelling Roar
1879316295.desc: Knocks an enemy down for a short duration from range.

1879368647.name: Blue Peahen
1879368647.desc: Brings out a blue peahen to keep you company.

1879385159.name: Snowy Barn Owl
1879385159.desc: Brings out a snowy barn owl to keep you company.

1879447367.name: Golden Crystal Beetle
1879447367.desc: Brings out a shimmering beetle to keep you company.

1879451335.name: Boon of Toxic Flesh
1879451335.desc: You bring out the corrupt nature of your ally's flesh, improving their defences.

1879452871.name: Minor Ballad - Dissonance
1879452871.desc: Boosts Tactical damage and harms your foe.\n\nBallads unlock Anthems and Codas.

1879461703.name: Return to Clegur
1879461703.desc: You're able to quickly return to Clegur in Swanfleet. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879483335.name: Reveal Weakness
1879483335.desc: Weaken enemy defences, increasing damage taken from attacks.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Chain Skills have a chance to grant you a Critical Response.

1879486023.name: Call to Arms: Archer (Temamir Hunter)
1879486023.desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879491527.name: Muster at Maurûsh
1879491527.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Ub Nishir, near Maurûsh in Urash Dâr in the Ikorbân Valley.

1879522375.name: Routing Cry
1879522375.desc: Deals Light damage to nearby foes, and draws threat from nearby fellows to yourself.\n\nThis skill is more potent when used with a Defeat Event.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879526599.name: Prepare: Wisp of Flame
1879526599.desc: Adherents of Balefire have learned to harness power as their enemy burns.

1879528263.name: Prepared: Wisp of Shadow
1879528263.desc: Send a shadowy spike at your target, dealing damage and reducing their tactical prowess.

conditionalEffects.description: Shadow Wisp, Spike, and Breath gain the ability to tier up the Seeing Shadows effect if present, up to Tier 3.
